description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for room management in a multiplayer game backend, including listing, creating, joining, and leaving rooms, with Swagger documentation annotations.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all rooms, invoking roomsController.list.

methods.name: router.post('/')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new room, protected by authRequired middleware, invoking roomsController.create.

methods.name: router.post('/:id/join')
methods.description: Handles POST requests for a user to join a room, protected by authRequired, invoking roomsController.join.

methods.name: router.post('/:id/leave')
methods.description: Handles POST requests for a user to leave a room, protected by authRequired, invoking roomsController.leave.
